statement.notes: The 'depreciation_and_amortization' field is directly mapped from the single line item 'Depreciation and amortization' in the operating activities section of the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows. The supplementary tables contain details on operating lease assets and liabilities, but the amortization of these right-of-use assets is already included in the consolidated 'Depreciation and amortization' figure. Therefore, no additional elements from the supplementary tables are required to make up the total value for this field.
